mismatch_axis: producer-controlled completeness to untrusted transport completeness
requested_feature: Add opt-in ingestion of two-byte length-prefixed frames while retaining raw ingestion.
second_mismatch_guard: Both states use the same bytes format, sink, return type, and synchronous call path; only who controls frame completeness changes.
secure_adaptation: Require an exact prefix/body length match before persisting the framed payload.
security_witness: A truncated external frame must be rejected without writing anything to the sink.
source_procedure: Prefix a payload with its two-byte length, read that declared length back, slice the body, and persist the slice.
source_valid_assumption: The frame is constructed in the same call from the complete in-memory payload, so its declared length always equals the available body length.
target_change: The service now accepts a complete-looking frame supplied by an external transport, which may be truncated or contain trailing bytes.
title: Generated frame to externally supplied frame
unsafe_reuse: Read the prefix and slice exactly as in the source, silently persisting a short body when the external frame is truncated.
